caption: The image displays a piece of embroidered textile featuring a variety of stylized flowers and foliage arranged over a dark blue background. The central motif is a large, fan-shaped flower with pinkish-red petals and a tan border, accompanied by a curved green stem and leaves. Surrounding this main flower are multiple other floral elements in colors such as cream, red, pink, yellow, and pale blue, each with distinct petal shapes and sizes. Some flowers are solitary while others are connected by slender, branched stems in gold and brown shades. The composition is dense, with flowers, leaves, and stems filling most of the fabric, leaving only small areas of the dark blue background exposed. The edges of the textile are uneven and frayed, revealing a lighter underlayer. The stitching varies in direction and texture, contributing to the rich surface pattern of the embroidery.
title: Embroidery
